questionResults.question: How many pantries are in each city?
questionResults.sql: SELECT a.city, COUNT(p.pantry_id) AS pantry_count FROM pantry p JOIN adress a ON a.address_id = p.address_id GROUP BY a.city;

questionResults.question: What is the total quantity of food in each pantry, including shelves and cupboards?
questionResults.sql:
SELECT p.pantry_id, (IFNULL(SUM(s.quantity), 0) + IFNULL(SUM(c.quantity), 0)) AS total_quantity
FROM pantry p
LEFT JOIN shelfs s ON p.pantry_id = s.pantry_id
LEFT JOIN cupboards c ON p.pantry_id = c.pantry_id
GROUP BY p.pantry_id;

questionResults.question: Which foods have no best-by date?
questionResults.sql: SELECT food_name, quantity FROM shelfs WHERE best_by_date IS NULL UNION SELECT food_name, quantity FROM cupboards WHERE best_by_date IS NULL;
questionResults.friendlyResponse: Granulated Sugar and Honey have no best-by date.

questionResults.question: Which in-stock foods have a best-by date before March 1, 2027?
Which pantries have more than 10 total units of food?
questionResults.sql:
SELECT p.pantry_id
FROM pantry p
JOIN (
    SELECT pantry_id, SUM(quantity) as total_quantity
    FROM (
        SELECT pantry_id, quantity FROM shelfs
        UNION ALL
        SELECT pantry_id, quantity FROM cupboards
    ) AS all_foods
    GROUP BY pantry_id
) AS food_totals ON p.pantry_id = food_totals.pantry_id
WHERE food_totals.total_quantity > 10
ORDER BY p.pantry_id;
questionResults.friendlyResponse: Pantries 1 and 2 have more than 10 total units of food.
